entities.name: Council of Jerusalem
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The first major Church council (c. 49 CE, Acts 15), which decided that Gentile converts need not follow the full Mosaic Law. A pivotal moment that enabled Christianity's expansion beyond Judaism into the Gentile world.
